title: Day and Trial Passes: visits granted, validity window, daily visit limit, and blackout dates
content:
This document covers the Day and Trial Passes product line: how many visits each tier grants, how long the pass remains valid, how many visits count toward usage per calendar day, whether the tier tracks a fixed number of visits, and whether published holiday blackout dates apply.

## Per-tier basis

| Tier | Visits included | Validity (days) | Daily visit limit | Multi-visit punch card | Blackout dates apply |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Single Day Pass | 1 | 1 | 1 | No | Yes |
| Three-Day Trial Pass | 3 | 3 | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Seven-Day Trial Pass | -1 (unlimited) | 7 | 1 | No | Yes |
| Weekly Visitor Pass | -1 (unlimited) | 7 | 2 | No | No |
| Monthly Trial Pass | -1 (unlimited) | 30 | 2 | No | No |
| Corporate Guest Pass | 1 | 1 | 1 | No | Yes |

A visits-included value of -1 denotes unlimited visits within the tier's validity window rather than a fixed count; any other value is the exact number of visits granted at purchase. The validity window runs for the listed number of calendar days from the date the pass's validity begins. The daily visit limit is the maximum number of visits that count toward usage in a single calendar day for that tier, regardless of how many times the visitor checks in that day. A tier flagged as a multi-visit punch card tracks a fixed number of visits rather than allowing unlimited use; the Three-Day Trial Pass is the only tier so flagged, consistent with its fixed 3-visit allowance. Where blackout dates apply to a tier, the pass is unusable on the published holiday blackout dates; the Weekly Visitor Pass and the Monthly Trial Pass are the only tiers not subject to blackout dates.
